import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int[] l = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            l[i] = sc.nextInt() % k;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(l[0]);
            return;
        }

        int[] l1 = Arrays.copyOfRange(l, 0, n / 2);
        int[] l2 = Arrays.copyOfRange(l, n / 2, n);
        Set<Integer> sSet = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> s1Set = new HashSet<>();

        // Generate all sums for first half
        for (int val : l1) {
            Set<Integer> tempSet = new HashSet<>();
            for (int j : sSet) {
                tempSet.add((j + val) % k);
            }
            sSet.add(val);
            sSet.addAll(tempSet);
        }

        // Generate all sums for second half
        for (int val : l2) {
            Set<Integer> tempSet = new HashSet<>();
            for (int j : s1Set) {
                tempSet.add((j + val) % k);
            }
            s1Set.add(val);
            s1Set.addAll(tempSet);
        }

        List<Integer> s = new ArrayList<>(sSet);
        List<Integer> s1 = new ArrayList<>(s1Set);
        Collections.sort(s);
        Collections.sort(s1);

        int ans = Math.max(s.get(s.size() - 1), s1.get(s1.size() - 1));
        for (int si : s) {
            int t = k - 1 - si;
            int ind = binarySearchCount(s1, t);
            int r = s1.get(ind - 1);
            int rt = s1.get(s1.size() - 1);
            ans = Math.max(ans, Math.max((r + si) % k, (si + rt) % k));
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    // Binary search to find count of elements less than or equal to key
    private static int binarySearchCount(List<Integer> list, int key) {
        int left = 0;
        int right = list.size() - 1;
        int count = 0;
        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) <= key) {
                count = mid + 1;
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
}
